name: working-the-board
title_zh: 跨仓库自动认领下一张票并开出收尾 PR 的看板工
tagline_zh: 不用再翻三个仓库找「下一步该做啥」。它替你锁定那张没人认领的票，直接开 PR 把活干完，让看板自己往前走。
tagline_en: Stop hunting across repos for 'what's next'. It locks the unclaimed ticket, opens the PR that closes it, and.
desc_en: Use when working a roadmap, board, epic, ticket, issue, sprint or "what's next" - selects the next actionable item across repositories, claims it, and opens a PR that closes it
why_zh: 它把「选票—认领—开 PR」压成一个原子动作，且跨仓库排序。
why_en: It collapses ticket-picking, claiming, and PR-opening into one atomic move, sorted across repos—no more human triage across.
limit_zh: 只认 GitHub 生态的 issue/PR 工作流，且要求仓库已有清晰的就绪标签或里程碑排序；若看板靠人工口头派活。
limit_en: GitHub-only workflow; needs ready-labels or milestone ordering. On verbally-assigned boards without structured metadata, it mispicks or stalls.
title_en: Claims the next ticket across repos and opens the closing PR
